description: Golden cases for querying a persisted continuous profile, shared by internal/profiler (Go: QueryProfile, which summarizes with internal/flame's frame table; conformance_test.go) and cf-controller/src/profile-query.ts (queryProfile; cf-controller/test/conformance.test.ts): a finished command's profile, queried on the controller, must read as the worker's live one does. `profile` is a CommandProfile and each query's `request` a GetProfileRequest, both as protobuf JSON. `want` is the summary both sides make of the reply: its sample counts, its frames table (listed once each, keyed by name and frame type, so frames that differ only in module, source file or line are one, the first seen's), its stacks as flamegraph.pl folded lines (`labels samples leafType comm`, a kernel frame's label ending _[k]), its top functions by frame label, and its timeline buckets, whose top frame is a label (null when none) and whose stack indexes name the reply's stacks.
